_comment: Rule 2 detection (design section 7). A transcript line counts as addressed to the assistant if (a) it starts with one of address_words used as a form of address, that is followed by a comma, colon or exclamation mark ("Assistant, ...", "Hey bot: ..."), with an optional greeting from greetings before it, or (b) it contains one of instruction_phrases (case-insensitive). Such a line may not be the only transcript evidence of a change. The lists are fixed with the system; false blocks on legitimate changes are counted in the evaluation.
